critical.issue: Revenue edits are still accepted after submission. Failing test trace: test_submitted_revenue_is_locked_for_edits -> expected 400/409, got 200 with {"message":"Revenue information updated"}.

Keep lock behavior period-aware and return 400/409 with clear detail when update is attempted post-submit.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/modules/supplier_assessment/service.py::update_revenue_info has no submitted-state guard; this bypasses submission lock intent.
backend/modules/supplier_assessment/router.py remains very large, increasing regression risk for cross-module changes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for executed requested admin UI checks

context_for_next_testing_agent: UI checks validated: suppliers page load, reminder module choices + reporting period, add-supplier reporting period + existing assignment controls, documents assignment picker search/pagination, trainings admin assignment picker search/pagination (on /supplier-assessment/trainings). Backend reminder payload acceptance and parent ESG manual scoring auth/validation pass. Revenue lock bug remains.
rca of the issue: Root cause: submitted state is only enforced in submit_revenue_info (duplicate-submit guard), but update_revenue_info lacks any check against existing submitted revenue for the active reporting period. Reproduction: submit revenue once, then call PUT /api/supplier-assessment/my-assessment/revenue with new values; API returns 200 and mutates data instead of rejecting as locked.
